svg.title: Unitree A2-centered ROS 2 system architecture
svg.desc: The Unitree A2 connects through its PC1 port to an Intel Panther Lake computer. The computer also connects to a Velodyne VLP-16 lidar over a separate Ethernet interface.
svg.text: ROS 2 compute, motion control, and lidar perception
[*] Motion Control Computing Unit specification supplied in the system documentation.
